oracle.correct_type: kind == type AND the validated choice's ref argument resolves, in the same step's Driver snapshot ref index, to role textbox whose name equals the fixture's own aria-label of input[name=value] (read from the fixture page source) AND the fixture shows 0 input events, 0 submits and submitted == null after the trial

oracle.recorded: request field names (state key paths, question names, criteria ids, instructions sha256/16, state sha256/16) and input/output token counts; no bodies, headers, values or credentials
